correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a specified fixed point makes all remaining value assignments uniformly ordered. If that index lies in the window, precisely binomial(i-1,k-1)binomial(n-i,m-k) sets of remaining values realize its ranked pattern, divided by the falling factorial. Outside the window relative orders are uniform. Summing the exact local kernel invokes the kth-order-statistic Vandermonde convolution, giving a nonnegative boundary penalty; positive witnesses at i=k and i=n-m+k prove strictness for every off-diagonal pattern rank. For cyclic starts, every rank offset traverses all n indices so the full convolution cancels. The m=3 table and changeover follow polynomial simplification. The standalone checker passed 13254 exact assertions, including direct enumeration, but the infinite claims rest on the proof.

value.rationale: A single all-length structural theorem explains how fixed absolute labels interact with relative local-order motifs. It proves a sharp unique pattern maximizer at every finite n,m and exact disappearance under cyclic boundary conditions; the complete length-three signed table has a nontrivial finite-size minimum shift. The object and statistics are standard in random permutations and pattern statistics, and the rank-boundary mechanism supplies reusable understanding beyond a routine marginal enumeration.
